name: Cascade Biotech Thermoregulation Hood
description:
A close-fitting hood with integrated thermoregulation circuits that maintain a stable temperature around the head and neck regardless of external conditions. The hood uses body-heat harvesting to power its micro-heating elements in cold environments and phase-change material packets to absorb excess heat in warm ones. No batteries required.

Designed for workers in extreme-temperature environments — foundry floors, refrigerated storage, exposed rooftops in summer. The hood's self-powering design means it works indefinitely without charging, making it valuable in off-grid situations.
functionality: Passive thermoregulation, no external power required, extreme temperature tolerance
what_it_says: Your work environment would cook or freeze an unprotected brain, and you handle it without thinking.
story_hooks: A maintenance worker wearing a Thermoregulation Hood survived an industrial accident that killed three unprotected coworkers — now the families want to know why only one person had the right gear.
